verdict.rationale: GitLab's docs say you can scale a self-hosted installation using recommended configurations, deployed via the Linux package, Docker images, or Helm chart/Operator for cloud-native installs. However, the evidence never names reference architectures or gives any user-count tiers, so the 'tens of thousands of users' part is unproven. Missing for 10: explicit reference-architecture documentation with user-count sizing (e.g., 10k–50k users), HA/component topology details, and independent or hands-on corroboration of large-scale self-hosted deployments.
